name: rule
definition: The value in force for a named rule in a scope: the registry default for the row family or verb, replaced by the newest live signed config, policy or charter row.
parameters: name (cap, window, threshold, protocol, vocabulary, confirm flag, family class); scope; instant
status_where: manifests/governance_policy.json (window_classes, min_count, base_law, protocols, families rows); reactions.json dur/max names resolving to constitution/constants.tsv; family_model.json default_row and per-family fold (newest config row: pick=max(version))

name: state
signature: (row or slot, t) -> live | pending | superseded | withdrawn | recanted | expired, with the instant the answer next changes
definition: The lifecycle of a held row, or the one current row in a slot, from its own term, the entitled retiring rows naming it, and the order of rivals.
parameters: row or slot; instant (now, signed instant, first held)
status_where: transitions.json states and from/to/change cells; family_model.json lifecycle, freshness and the default fold (pick=rank(recants>withdraws>supersedes),max(asserted_at),min(attestation_id)); reactions.json expiry and clock entries for the next-change instant; models formal/event_lifecycle, withdraws_admission, takedown, retirement

name: stands
signature: (key, role, anchor, t) -> yes with chain depth | no ; inverse: (role, anchor, t) -> set of keys
definition: Whether a key holds a role (owner, member, founder, moderator, steward, seat, duty, delegate, trusted root) under an anchor, by walking live binding and delegation rows from the anchor to the key.
parameters: role; anchor (a group, a node, a content, or the reader's trust set); instant
status_where: transitions.json roles (23 role tokens) and family_model.json signer_rule (who x via delegates_to x conditions) state which role is required; models formal/standing, authority_tree, trust_set, trust_root, owner_binding, membership, self_roster state how owner, member, holder and trusted are reached. The column that says which rows confer a role (family_model confers) is a gap for all 184 families

name: tally
signature: (pattern, scope, t) -> weighted count of distinct standing signers, and met | pending | expired against the threshold
definition: The count of live rows matching a pattern, one per standing signer, weighed and compared with the rule's threshold.
parameters: row pattern (cosign, objection, custody claim, co-scrub, ballot); weight; threshold rule
status_where: governance_policy.json (decider, counted_columns, protocols, min_count) and family_model.json count and cosign_rule state every governance count; models formal/two_path, accord_roster, ranked_choice, census_ballot. The holder count over custody rows is not stated: custody:{kind} has an empty fold cell and count none, though constants.tsv has replication_target_cap

name: may_act
signature: (actor, verb, target, t) -> direct | propose | refuse with a reason
definition: Whether an actor may perform an act on a target: the actor stands in the role the rule requires, the target is in a state the verb allows, and any required count is met. Admission of an arrived row is this answer for its signer at the instant first held.
parameters: verb or row family; instant (now for a pre-check or a control, first held for admission)
status_where: transitions.json: the _meta rule "queue(view, standing) = transitions of the family whose from = view.state and whose roles meet standing; the door admits by the same predicate", with columns roles, policy, guard, undo, confirm; model formal/event_lifecycle (the queue is the door run forwards). Guards are typed for 26 of 459 transitions

name: audience
signature: (row, t) -> everyone | set of principals and their devices
definition: Who may hold a row: from its scope, the charter of its group, the roster, and the live grants and consents naming others.
parameters: row; instant; test form: peer in audience
status_where: family_model.json replication (tier, audience, non_recipient, held), placement and subject_rule.in_audience; transitions.json widens; models formal/standing (audience rule), key_plane, transport_tiers, contact. placement is a gap for 156 of 184 families and replication is of mixed source for 176

name: missing
definition: The rows a held or offered row depends on that the node does not hold: signer key, target, parent, grant, chunk.
status_where: family_model.json reference (pre:/carry: for 35 families), replication.held (settle_on_key | refuse) and the ref:* clause of the guard grammar name what a row depends on. Nothing states the wait: no clock in reactions.json for a row offered but not admitted, and no model
